misprints.note: The scan clearly reads -μεθαι. It is the perfect 1st plural of παραδέχεσθαι, so the final ι is the printer's error.
There is no comma before the article, unlike every other entry.

uncertain.note: The abbreviation is set in a face that looks like italic Greek υυ. I transcribed it as Swedish 'vv.' (verb), as the book's abbreviations require. The same applies to 'nämnda vv.' in 0104_01 and 'gm vv.' in 0104_02.
After γῆ there is only a faint, broken dot. I read it as a full stop.
The mark after ῆρος is small and broken. It looks more like a comma than a full stop.
The breathing is small. It looks smooth, unlike the rough breathing on ἑξῆς beside it.
